verses.original: Ἐπειδήπερ πολλοὶ ἐπεχείρησαν ἀνατάξασθαι διήγησιν περὶ τῶν πεπληροφορημένων ἐν ἡμῖν πραγμάτων
verses.transliteration: Epeidēper polloi epecheirēsan anataxasthai diēgēsin peri tōn peplērophorēmenōn en hēmin pragmatōn
verses.literal: Many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us
verses.literalPt: Tendo muitos empreendido fazer uma narração coordenada dos fatos que entre nós se realizaram,

verses.original: καθὼς παρέδοσαν ἡμῖν οἱ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς αὐτόπται καὶ ὑπηρέται γενόμενοι τοῦ λόγου
verses.transliteration: kathōs paredosan hēmin hoi ap’ archēs autoptai kai hypēretai genomenoi tou logou
verses.literal: just as they were handed down to us by the initial eyewitnesses and servants of the word
verses.literalPt: como no-los transmitiram os que foram deles testemunhas oculares desde o princípio e ministros da palavra

verses.original: ἔδοξε κἀμοὶ παρηκολουθηκότι ἄνωθεν πᾶσιν ἀκριβῶς καθεξῆς σοι γράψαι κράτιστε Θεόφιλε
verses.transliteration: edoxe kamoi parēkolouthēkoti anōthen pasin akribōs kathexēs soi grapsai kratiste Theophile
verses.literal: Therefore, having carefully investigated . . . everything from the beginning it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you most excellent Theophilus
verses.literalPt: também a mim, depois de haver investigado tudo cuidadosamente desde o começo, pareceu-me bem, excelentíssimo Teófilo, dar-te por escrito uma narração em ordem,

verses.original: ἵνα ἐπιγνῷς περὶ ὧν κατηχήθης λόγων τὴν ἀσφάλειαν
verses.transliteration: hina epignōs peri hōn katēchēthēs logōn tēn asphaleian
verses.literal: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught
verses.literalPt: para que conheças a verdade das coisas em que foste instruído.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου βασιλέως τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἱερεύς τις ὀνόματι Ζαχαρίας ἐξ ἐφημερίας Ἀβιά καὶ γυνὴ αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Ἀαρών καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Ἐλισάβετ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto en tais hēmerais Hērōdou basileōs tēs Ioudaias hiereus tis onomati Zacharias ex ephēmerias Abia kai gynē autō ek tōn thygaterōn Aarōn kai to onoma autēs Elisabet
verses.literal: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah and whose wife Elizabeth was a descendant of Aaron
verses.literalPt: Nos dias de Herodes, rei da Judeia, houve um sacerdote chamado Zacarias, da turma de Abias; sua mulher era descendente de Arão, e chamava-se Isabel.

verses.original: ἦσαν δὲ δίκαιοι ἀμφότεροι ἐναντίον τοῦ Θεοῦ πορευόμενοι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐντολαῖς καὶ δικαιώμασιν τοῦ Κυρίου ἄμεμπτοι
verses.transliteration: ēsan de dikaioi amphoteroi enantion tou Theou poreuomenoi en pasais tais entolais kai dikaiōmasin tou Kyriou amemptoi
verses.literal: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Ambos eram justos diante de Deus, andando irrepreensíveis em todos os mandamentos e preceitos do Senhor.

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τέκνον καθότι ἦν ἡ Ἐλισάβετ στεῖρα καὶ ἀμφότεροι προβεβηκότες ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ἦσαν
verses.transliteration: kai ouk ēn autois teknon kathoti ēn hē Elisabet steira kai amphoteroi probebēkotes en tais hēmerais autōn ēsan
verses.literal: But they had no children because Elizabeth was barren and they were both well along in - years
verses.literalPt: Eles não tinham filhos, porquanto Isabel era estéril, e ambos, de idade avançada.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἱερατεύειν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ τάξει τῆς ἐφημερίας αὐτοῦ ἔναντι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tō hierateuein auton en tē taxei tēs ephēmerias autou enanti tou Theou
verses.literal: One day . . . while Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God
verses.literalPt: Estando Zacarias a exercer diante de Deus as funções sacerdotais na ordem da sua turma, coube-lhe por sorte,

verses.original: κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἱερατείας ἔλαχε τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: kata to ethos tēs hierateias elache tou thymiasai eiselthōn eis ton naon tou Kyriou
verses.literal: he was chosen by lot according to the custom of the priesthood to enter . . . the temple of the Lord and burn incense
verses.literalPt: segundo o costume do sacerdócio, entrar no santuário do Senhor e queimar o incenso;

verses.original: καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ἦν τοῦ λαοῦ προσευχόμενον ἔξω τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ θυμιάματος
verses.transliteration: kai pan to plēthos ēn tou laou proseuchomenon exō tē hōra tou thymiamatos
verses.literal: And at the hour of the incense offering the whole congregation . . . . . . was praying outside
verses.literalPt: toda a multidão do povo estava orando da parte de fora, à hora do incenso.

verses.original: Ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος Κυρίου ἑστὼς ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ θυμιάματος
verses.transliteration: Ōphthē de autō angelos Kyriou hestōs ek dexiōn tou thysiastēriou tou thymiamatos
verses.literal: Just then an angel of the Lord appeared to Zechariah standing at the right side of the altar of incense
verses.literalPt: Apareceu a Zacarias um anjo do Senhor, em pé à direita do altar do incenso.

verses.original: καὶ ἐταράχθη Ζαχαρίας ἰδών καὶ φόβος ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai etarachthē Zacharias idōn kai phobos epepesen ep’ auton
verses.literal: When Zechariah saw him he was startled and gripped . . . . . . with fear
verses.literalPt: Zacarias, vendo-o, ficou turbado, e o temor o assaltou.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος Μὴ φοβοῦ Ζαχαρία διότι εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς σου καὶ ἡ γυνή σου Ἐλισάβετ γεννήσει υἱόν σοι καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννην
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros auton ho angelos Mē phobou Zacharia dioti eisēkousthē hē deēsis sou kai hē gynē sou Elisabet gennēsei huion soi kai kaleseis to onoma autou Iōannēn
verses.literal: But the angel said to him Do not be afraid Zechariah because your prayer has been heard Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son and you are to give him the name John
verses.literalPt: Mas o anjo lhe disse: Não temas, Zacarias, porque a tua oração foi ouvida, e Isabel, tua mulher, te dará à luz um filho, a quem chamarás João;

verses.original: καὶ ἔσται χαρά σοι καὶ ἀγαλλίασις καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τῇ γενέσει αὐτοῦ χαρήσονται
verses.transliteration: kai estai chara soi kai agalliasis kai polloi epi tē genesei autou charēsontai
verses.literal: He will be a joy and delight to you and many will rejoice at his birth
verses.literalPt: terás gozo e alegria, e muitos se regozijarão com o seu nascimento.

verses.original: ἔσται γὰρ μέγας ἐνώπιον τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ οἶνον καὶ σίκερα οὐ μὴ πίῃ καὶ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου πλησθήσεται ἔτι ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: estai gar megas enōpion tou Kyriou kai oinon kai sikera ou mē piē kai Pneumatos Hagiou plēsthēsetai eti ek koilias mētros autou
verses.literal: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord He shall never take wine or strong drink and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb
verses.literalPt: Pois ele será grande diante do Senhor e não beberá vinho nem bebida forte; já desde o ventre de sua mãe será cheio do Espírito Santo

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐπιστρέψει ἐπὶ Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai pollous tōn huiōn Israēl epistrepsei epi Kyrion ton Theon autōn
verses.literal: Many of the sons of Israel he will turn back to the Lord their God
verses.literalPt: e converterá muitos dos filhos de Israel ao Senhor, Deus deles.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς προελεύσεται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ δυνάμει Ἠλίου ἐπιστρέψαι καρδίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀπειθεῖς ἐν φρονήσει δικαίων ἑτοιμάσαι Κυρίῳ λαὸν κατεσκευασμένον
verses.transliteration: kai autos proeleusetai enōpion autou en pneumati kai dynamei Ēliou epistrepsai kardias paterōn epi tekna kai apeitheis en phronēsei dikaiōn hetoimasai Kyriō laon kateskeuasmenon
verses.literal: And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous to make ready a people prepared for the Lord
verses.literalPt: Ele irá adiante do Senhor no espírito e poder de Elias, para converter os corações dos pais aos filhos e converter os desobedientes, de maneira que andem na prudência dos justos, a fim de preparar para o Senhor um povo dedicado.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν Ζαχαρίας πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον Κατὰ τί γνώσομαι τοῦτο ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι πρεσβύτης καὶ ἡ γυνή μου προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen Zacharias pros ton angelon Kata ti gnōsomai touto egō gar eimi presbytēs kai hē gynē mou probebēkuia en tais hēmerais autēs
verses.literal: How can I be sure of this Zechariah asked . . . the angel I am an old man and my wife is well along in - years
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Zacarias ao anjo: Como terei certeza disso? Porque eu sou velho, e minha mulher já é de idade avançada.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἐγώ εἰμι Γαβριὴλ ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἀπεστάλην λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ καὶ εὐαγγελίσασθαί σοι ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho angelos eipen autō Egō eimi Gabriēl ho parestēkōs enōpion tou Theou kai apestalēn lalēsai pros se kai euangelisasthai soi tauta
verses.literal: I am Gabriel replied . . . . . . the angel I stand in the presence of God and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o anjo: Eu sou Gabriel, que assisto diante de Deus e fui enviado a falar-te e a trazer-te estas boas novas;

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔσῃ σιωπῶν καὶ μὴ δυνάμενος λαλῆσαι ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας γένηται ταῦτα ἀνθ’ ὧν οὐκ ἐπίστευσας τοῖς λόγοις μου οἵτινες πληρωθήσονται εἰς τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai idou esē siōpōn kai mē dynamenos lalēsai achri hēs hēmeras genētai tauta anth’ hōn ouk episteusas tois logois mou hoitines plērōthēsontai eis ton kairon autōn
verses.literal: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass because . . . you did not believe my words which will be fulfilled at their proper time
verses.literalPt: tu ficarás mudo e não poderás falar, até o dia em que essas coisas acontecerem, porque não deste crédito às minhas palavras, que a seu tempo se hão de cumprir.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς προσδοκῶν τὸν Ζαχαρίαν καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐν τῷ χρονίζειν ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn ho laos prosdokōn ton Zacharian kai ethaumazon en tō chronizein en tō naō auton
verses.literal: Meanwhile the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple
verses.literalPt: O povo estava esperando a Zacarias e maravilhava-se, enquanto ele se demorava no santuário.

verses.original: ἐξελθὼν δὲ οὐκ ἐδύνατο λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν ὅτι ὀπτασίαν ἑώρακεν ἐν τῷ ναῷ καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν διανεύων αὐτοῖς καὶ διέμενεν κωφός
verses.transliteration: exelthōn de ouk edynato lalēsai autois kai epegnōsan hoti optasian heōraken en tō naō kai autos ēn dianeuōn autois kai diemenen kōphos
verses.literal: When he came out and was unable to speak to them they realized he had seen a vision in the temple He kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak
verses.literalPt: Quando ele saiu, não lhes podia falar, e perceberam que tinha tido uma visão no santuário; ele lhes fazia acenos e continuou mudo.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς λειτουργίας αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto hōs eplēsthēsan hai hēmerai tēs leitourgias autou apēlthen eis ton oikon autou
verses.literal: And . . . when the days of his service were complete he returned home
verses.literalPt: Cumpridos os dias do seu ministério, retirou-se para sua casa.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ ταύτας τὰς ἡμέρας συνέλαβεν Ἐλισάβετ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ περιέκρυβεν ἑαυτὴν μῆνας πέντε λέγουσα
verses.transliteration: Meta de tautas tas hēmeras synelaben Elisabet hē gynē autou kai periekryben heautēn mēnas pente legousa
verses.literal: After these days his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion . . . She declared
verses.literalPt: Depois desses dias, Isabel, sua mulher, concebeu e ocultou-se por cinco meses, dizendo:

verses.original: ὅτι Οὕτως μοι πεποίηκεν Κύριος ἐν ἡμέραις αἷς ἐπεῖδεν ἀφελεῖν ὄνειδός μου ἐν ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: hoti Houtōs moi pepoiēken Kyrios en hēmerais hais epeiden aphelein oneidos mou en anthrōpois
verses.literal: The Lord has done this for me In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people
verses.literalPt: Assim me fez o Senhor nos dias em que ele pôs os olhos sobre mim, para acabar com o meu opróbrio entre os homens.

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἕκτῳ ἀπεστάλη ὁ ἄγγελος Γαβριὴλ ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας ᾗ ὄνομα Ναζαρὲθ
verses.transliteration: En de tō mēni tō hektō apestalē ho angelos Gabriēl apo tou Theou eis polin tēs Galilaias hē onoma Nazareth
verses.literal: In the sixth month God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth
verses.literalPt: No sexto mês, foi enviado, da parte de Deus, o anjo Gabriel a uma cidade da Galileia, chamada Nazaré,

verses.original: πρὸς παρθένον ἐμνηστευμένην ἀνδρὶ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰωσὴφ ἐξ οἴκου Δαυὶδ καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς παρθένου Μαριάμ
verses.transliteration: pros parthenon emnēsteumenēn andri hō onoma Iōsēph ex oikou Dauid kai to onoma tēs parthenou Mariam
verses.literal: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph who was of the house of David And the virgin’s name was Mary
verses.literalPt: a uma virgem desposada com um homem que se chamava José, da casa de Davi; o nome da virgem era Maria.

verses.original: καὶ εἰσελθὼν πρὸς αὐτὴν εἶπεν Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη ὁ Κύριος μετὰ σοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai eiselthōn pros autēn eipen Chaire kecharitōmenē ho Kyrios meta sou
verses.literal: The angel appeared to her and said Greetings you who are highly favored The Lord is with you
verses.literalPt: Aproximando-se dela, disse: Salve, altamente favorecida! O Senhor é contigo.

verses.original: Ἡ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ διεταράχθη καὶ διελογίζετο ποταπὸς εἴη ὁ ἀσπασμὸς οὗτος
verses.transliteration: Hē de epi tō logō dietarachthē kai dielogizeto potapos eiē ho aspasmos houtos
verses.literal: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be
verses.literalPt: Ela, porém, ao ouvir essas palavras, perturbou-se muito e pôs-se a pensar que saudação seria esta.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτῇ Μὴ φοβοῦ Μαριάμ εὗρες γὰρ χάριν παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: kai eipen ho angelos autē Mē phobou Mariam heures gar charin para tō Theō
verses.literal: So the angel told her Do not be afraid Mary for you have found favor with God
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe o anjo: Não temas, Maria pois achaste graça diante de Deus.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ συλλήμψῃ ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: kai idou syllēmpsē en gastri kai texē huion kai kaleseis to onoma autou Iēsoun
verses.literal: Behold you will conceive . . . . . . and give birth to a son and you are to give Him the name Jesus
verses.literalPt: Conceberás no teu ventre e darás à luz um filho, a quem chamarás JESUS.

verses.original: οὗτος ἔσται μέγας καὶ Υἱὸς Ὑψίστου κληθήσεται καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τὸν θρόνον Δαυὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos estai megas kai Huios Hypsistou klēthēsetai kai dōsei autō Kyrios ho Theos ton thronon Dauid tou patros autou
verses.literal: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David
verses.literalPt: Este será grande e será chamado Filho do Altíssimo; o Senhor Deus lhe dará o trono de seu pai Davi,

verses.original: καὶ βασιλεύσει ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰακὼβ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας καὶ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔσται τέλος
verses.transliteration: kai basileusei epi ton oikon Iakōb eis tous aiōnas kai tēs basileias autou ouk estai telos
verses.literal: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever - His kingdom will never end
verses.literalPt: e ele reinará eternamente sobre a casa de Jacó, e o seu reino não terá fim.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ Μαριὰμ πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον Πῶς ἔσται τοῦτο ἐπεὶ ἄνδρα οὐ γινώσκω
verses.transliteration: Eipen de Mariam pros ton angelon Pōs estai touto epei andra ou ginōskō
verses.literal: How can this be Mary asked the angel since I am a virgin . . .
verses.literalPt: Maria perguntou ao anjo: Como será isso, uma vez que não conheço varão?

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῇ Πνεῦμα Ἅγιον ἐπελεύσεται ἐπὶ σέ καὶ δύναμις Ὑψίστου ἐπισκιάσει σοι διὸ καὶ τὸ γεννώμενον ἅγιον κληθήσεται Υἱὸς Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho angelos eipen autē Pneuma Hagion epeleusetai epi se kai dynamis Hypsistou episkiasei soi dio kai to gennōmenon hagion klēthēsetai Huios Theou
verses.literal: The angel replied . . . . . . The Holy Spirit will come upon you and the power of the Most High will overshadow you So . . . the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe o anjo: O Espírito Santo virá sobre ti, e a virtude do Altíssimo te envolverá com a sua sombra; por isso, o que há de nascer será chamado santo, Filho de Deus.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἐλισάβετ ἡ συγγενίς σου καὶ αὐτὴ συνείληφεν υἱὸν ἐν γήρει αὐτῆς καὶ οὗτος μὴν ἕκτος ἐστὶν αὐτῇ τῇ καλουμένῃ στείρᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai idou Elisabet hē syngenis sou kai autē syneilēphen huion en gērei autēs kai houtos mēn hektos estin autē tē kaloumenē steira
verses.literal: Look even Elizabeth your relative - has conceived a son in her old age and she who was called barren is in her sixth month
verses.literalPt: Isabel, tua parenta, também ela concebeu um filho na sua velhice, e já está no sexto mês aquela que era chamada estéril;

verses.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἀδυνατήσει παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ πᾶν ῥῆμα
verses.transliteration: hoti ouk adynatēsei para tou Theou pan rhēma
verses.literal: For no word from God will ever fail
verses.literalPt: porque nenhuma palavra vinda de Deus será impossível.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ Μαριάμ Ἰδοὺ ἡ δούλη Κυρίου γένοιτό μοι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ὁ ἄγγελος
verses.transliteration: Eipen de Mariam Idou hē doulē Kyriou genoito moi kata to rhēma sou kai apēlthen ap’ autēs ho angelos
verses.literal: I am the Lord’s servant Mary answered May it happen to me according to your word Then the angel left . . . her
verses.literalPt: Disse Maria: Eis aqui a serva do Senhor; faça-se em mim segundo a tua palavra. E o anjo retirou-se.

verses.original: Ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Μαριὰμ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν μετὰ σπουδῆς εἰς πόλιν Ἰούδα
verses.transliteration: Anastasa de Mariam en tais hēmerais tautais eporeuthē eis tēn oreinēn meta spoudēs eis polin Iouda
verses.literal: In those days Mary got ready and hurried . . . . . . to a town in the hill country of Judah
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias, levantando-se Maria, foi apressadamente à região montanhosa, a uma cidade de Judá,

verses.original: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ζαχαρίου καὶ ἠσπάσατο τὴν Ἐλισάβετ
verses.transliteration: kai eisēlthen eis ton oikon Zachariou kai ēspasato tēn Elisabet
verses.literal: where she entered . . . the home of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth
verses.literalPt: entrou na casa de Zacarias e saudou a Isabel.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν τὸν ἀσπασμὸν τῆς Μαρίας ἡ Ἐλισάβετ ἐσκίρτησεν τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπλήσθη Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ἡ Ἐλισάβετ
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto hōs ēkousen ton aspasmon tēs Marias hē Elisabet eskirtēsen to brephos en tē koilia autēs kai eplēsthē Pneumatos Hagiou hē Elisabet
verses.literal: When . . . Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting the baby leaped in her womb and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Apenas Isabel ouviu a saudação de Maria, a criança deu saltos no ventre dela, e Isabel ficou cheia do Espírito Santo

verses.original: καὶ ἀνεφώνησεν κραυγῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ εἶπεν Εὐλογημένη σὺ ἐν γυναιξίν καὶ εὐλογημένος ὁ καρπὸς τῆς κοιλίας σου
verses.transliteration: kai anephōnēsen kraugē megalē kai eipen Eulogēmenē sy en gynaixin kai eulogēmenos ho karpos tēs koilias sou
verses.literal: In a loud voice she exclaimed . . . . . . Blessed are you among women and blessed is the fruit of your womb
verses.literalPt: e exclamou em alta voz: Bendita és tu entre as mulheres, e bendito é o fruto do teu ventre!

verses.original: καὶ πόθεν μοι τοῦτο ἵνα ἔλθῃ ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Κυρίου μου πρὸς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: kai pothen moi touto hina elthē hē mētēr tou Kyriou mou pros eme
verses.literal: And why am I so honored that the mother of my Lord should come to me
verses.literalPt: Como é que me vem visitar a mãe do meu Senhor?

verses.original: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡ φωνὴ τοῦ ἀσπασμοῦ σου εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου ἐσκίρτησεν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ μου
verses.transliteration: idou gar hōs egeneto hē phōnē tou aspasmou sou eis ta ōta mou eskirtēsen en agalliasei to brephos en tē koilia mou
verses.literal: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached . . . my ears the baby in my womb leaped for joy
verses.literalPt: Pois, logo que a voz da tua saudação chegou aos meus ouvidos, a criança deu saltos de alegria no meu ventre.

verses.original: καὶ μακαρία ἡ πιστεύσασα ὅτι ἔσται τελείωσις τοῖς λελαλημένοις αὐτῇ παρὰ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: kai makaria hē pisteusasa hoti estai teleiōsis tois lelalēmenois autē para Kyriou
verses.literal: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurada aquela que creu que se hão de cumprir as coisas que lhe foram ditas da parte do Senhor!

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν Μαριάμ Μεγαλύνει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen Mariam Megalynei hē psychē mou ton Kyrion
verses.literal: Then Mary said My soul magnifies the Lord
verses.literalPt: Disse Maria: A minha alma engrandece ao Senhor,

verses.original: καὶ ἠγαλλίασεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τῷ Θεῷ τῷ Σωτῆρί μου
verses.transliteration: kai ēgalliasen to pneuma mou epi tō Theō tō Sōtēri mou
verses.literal: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior
verses.literalPt: e o meu espírito alegrou-se em Deus meu Salvador,

verses.original: ὅτι ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῆς δούλης αὐτοῦ ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μακαριοῦσίν με πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαί
verses.transliteration: hoti epeblepsen epi tēn tapeinōsin tēs doulēs autou idou gar apo tou nyn makariousin me pasai hai geneai
verses.literal: For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant From now on all generations will call me blessed
verses.literalPt: porque pôs os olhos na baixeza da sua serva. pois, de ora em diante, todas as gerações me chamarão bem-aventurada,

verses.original: ὅτι ἐποίησέν μοι μεγάλα ὁ δυνατός καὶ ἅγιον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoti epoiēsen moi megala ho dynatos kai hagion to onoma autou
verses.literal: For the Mighty One has done great things for me Holy is His name
verses.literalPt: porque o Poderoso me fez grandes coisas. Santo é o seu nome.

verses.original: καὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γενεὰς τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai to eleos autou eis geneas kai geneas tois phoboumenois auton
verses.literal: His mercy extends to those who fear Him from generation to generation
verses.literalPt: E a sua misericórdia estende-se de geração em geração sobre os que o temem.

verses.original: Ἐποίησεν κράτος ἐν βραχίονι αὐτοῦ διεσκόρπισεν ὑπερηφάνους διανοίᾳ καρδίας αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Epoiēsen kratos en brachioni autou dieskorpisen hyperēphanous dianoia kardias autōn
verses.literal: He has performed mighty deeds with His arm He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts
verses.literalPt: Manifestou poder com o seu braço, dissipou os que tinham pensamentos soberbos no coração.

verses.original: καθεῖλεν δυνάστας ἀπὸ θρόνων καὶ ὕψωσεν ταπεινούς
verses.transliteration: katheilen dynastas apo thronōn kai hypsōsen tapeinous
verses.literal: He has brought down rulers from their thrones but has exalted the humble
verses.literalPt: Depôs os poderosos dos seus tronos e exaltou os humildes.

verses.original: πεινῶντας ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν καὶ πλουτοῦντας ἐξαπέστειλεν κενούς
verses.transliteration: peinōntas eneplēsen agathōn kai ploutountas exapesteilen kenous
verses.literal: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty
verses.literalPt: Encheu de bens os famintos e despediu vazios os ricos.

verses.original: ἀντελάβετο Ἰσραὴλ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ μνησθῆναι ἐλέους
verses.transliteration: antelabeto Israēl paidos autou mnēsthēnai eleous
verses.literal: He has helped His servant Israel remembering to be merciful
verses.literalPt: Socorreu a Israel, seu servo, lembrando-se de misericórdia

verses.original: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν τῷ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: kathōs elalēsen pros tous pateras hēmōn tō Abraam kai tō spermati autou eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: as He promised to our fathers to Abraham and his descendants forever
verses.literalPt: ( Como falou a nossos pais.) para com Abraão e a sua posteridade, para sempre.

verses.original: Ἔμεινεν δὲ Μαριὰμ σὺν αὐτῇ ὡς μῆνας τρεῖς καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Emeinen de Mariam syn autē hōs mēnas treis kai hypestrepsen eis ton oikon autēs
verses.literal: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home
verses.literalPt: Maria ficou cerca de três meses com ela; depois, voltou para sua casa.

verses.original: Τῇ δὲ Ἐλισάβετ ἐπλήσθη ὁ χρόνος τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱόν
verses.transliteration: Tē de Elisabet eplēsthē ho chronos tou tekein autēn kai egennēsen huion
verses.literal: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child she gave birth to a son
verses.literalPt: Chegado o tempo de dar à luz, Isabel teve um filho.

verses.original: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ περίοικοι καὶ οἱ συγγενεῖς αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνεν Κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ μετ’ αὐτῆς καὶ συνέχαιρον αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: kai ēkousan hoi perioikoi kai hoi syngeneis autēs hoti emegalynen Kyrios to eleos autou met’ autēs kai synechairon autē
verses.literal: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great . . . . . . . . . mercy and they rejoiced with her
verses.literalPt: Os seus vizinhos e parentes, sabendo da grande misericórdia que o Senhor manifestara para com ela, participavam do seu regozijo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἦλθον περιτεμεῖν τὸ παιδίον καὶ ἐκάλουν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαχαρίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tē hēmera tē ogdoē ēlthon peritemein to paidion kai ekaloun auto epi tō onomati tou patros autou Zacharian
verses.literal: On the eighth day when they came to circumcise the child they were going to name him after . . . . . . his father Zechariah
verses.literalPt: No oitavo dia, vieram circuncidar o menino e iam dar-lhe o nome de seu pai, Zacarias.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν Οὐχί ἀλλὰ κληθήσεται Ἰωάννης
verses.transliteration: kai apokritheisa hē mētēr autou eipen Ouchi alla klēthēsetai Iōannēs
verses.literal: But his mother replied . . . No He shall be called John
verses.literalPt: Sua mãe, porém, disse: Não! Mas será chamado João.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτὴν ὅτι Οὐδείς ἐστιν ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας σου ὃς καλεῖται τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipan pros autēn hoti Oudeis estin ek tēs syngeneias sou hos kaleitai tō onomati toutō
verses.literal: They said to her There is no one among your relatives who bears this name
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe: Ninguém há entre teus parentes que tenha esse nome.

verses.original: ἐνένευον δὲ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ τί ἂν θέλοι καλεῖσθαι αὐτό
verses.transliteration: eneneuon de tō patri autou to ti an theloi kaleisthai auto
verses.literal: So they made signs to his father to find out what . . . he wanted to name the child
verses.literalPt: Perguntavam, por acenos ao pai que nome queria que lhe pusessem.

verses.original: Καὶ αἰτήσας πινακίδιον ἔγραψεν λέγων Ἰωάννης ἐστὶν ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐθαύμασαν πάντες
verses.transliteration: Kai aitēsas pinakidion egrapsen legōn Iōannēs estin onoma autou kai ethaumasan pantes
verses.literal: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote His name is John And they were all amazed
verses.literalPt: Ele, pedindo uma tabuinha, escreveu: João é o seu nome. Todos se maravilharam.

verses.original: ἀνεῴχθη δὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ παραχρῆμα καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάλει εὐλογῶν τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: aneōchthē de to stoma autou parachrēma kai hē glōssa autou kai elalei eulogōn ton Theon
verses.literal: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released and he began to speak praising God
verses.literalPt: Imediatamente, lhe foi aberta a boca e solta a língua, e começou a falar, bendizendo a Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πάντας φόβος τοὺς περιοικοῦντας αὐτούς καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ὀρεινῇ τῆς Ἰουδαίας διελαλεῖτο πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto epi pantas phobos tous perioikountas autous kai en holē tē oreinē tēs Ioudaias dielaleito panta ta rhēmata tauta
verses.literal: All their neighbors . . . were filled with . . . awe and people throughout . . . the hill country of Judea were talking about these events
verses.literalPt: O temor apoderou-se de todos os seus vizinhos; divulgou-se a notícia de todas essas coisas por toda a região montanhosa da Judeia,

verses.original: καὶ ἔθεντο πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν λέγοντες Τί ἄρα τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο ἔσται καὶ γὰρ χεὶρ Κυρίου ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ethento pantes hoi akousantes en tē kardia autōn legontes Ti ara to paidion touto estai kai gar cheir Kyriou ēn met’ autou
verses.literal: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked What then will this child become For the Lord’s hand was with him
verses.literalPt: e todos os que delas souberam as guardaram no coração, dizendo: Que virá a ser, então, este menino? Pois, na verdade, a mão do Senhor era com ele.

verses.original: Καὶ Ζαχαρίας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐπλήσθη Πνεύματος Ἁγίου καὶ ἐπροφήτευσεν λέγων
verses.transliteration: Kai Zacharias ho patēr autou eplēsthē Pneumatos Hagiou kai eprophēteusen legōn
verses.literal: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied
verses.literalPt: Zacarias, seu pai, ficou cheio do Espírito Santo e profetizou, dizendo:

verses.original: Εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ ὅτι ἐπεσκέψατο καὶ ἐποίησεν λύτρωσιν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eulogētos Kyrios ho Theos tou Israēl hoti epeskepsato kai epoiēsen lytrōsin tō laō autou
verses.literal: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel because He has visited and redeemed His people
verses.literalPt: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus de Israel! Porque, visitou e remiu o seu povo,

verses.original: καὶ ἤγειρεν κέρας σωτηρίας ἡμῖν ἐν οἴκῳ Δαυὶδ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ēgeiren keras sōtērias hēmin en oikō Dauid paidos autou
verses.literal: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David
verses.literalPt: e nos suscitou um libertador poderoso na casa de Davi, seu servo,

verses.original: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν διὰ στόματος τῶν ἁγίων ἀπ’ αἰῶνος προφητῶν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kathōs elalēsen dia stomatos tōn hagiōn ap’ aiōnos prophētōn autou
verses.literal: as He spoke through . . . His holy prophets those of ages past
verses.literalPt: (Como anunciou desde o princípio pela boca dos seus santos profetas),

verses.original: σωτηρίαν ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν μισούντων ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: sōtērian ex echthrōn hēmōn kai ek cheiros pantōn tōn misountōn hēmas
verses.literal: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us
verses.literalPt: para nos livrar dos nossos inimigos e da mão de todos os que nos odeiam;

verses.original: ποιῆσαι ἔλεος μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ μνησθῆναι διαθήκης ἁγίας αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: poiēsai eleos meta tōn paterōn hēmōn kai mnēsthēnai diathēkēs hagias autou
verses.literal: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant
verses.literalPt: para usar de misericórdia com nossos pais e lembrar-se da sua santa aliança

verses.original: ὅρκον ὃν ὤμοσεν πρὸς Ἀβραὰμ τὸν πατέρα ἡμῶν τοῦ δοῦναι ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: horkon hon ōmosen pros Abraam ton patera hēmōn tou dounai hēmin
verses.literal: the oath He swore to our father Abraham to grant us
verses.literalPt: do juramento que fez a Abraão, nosso pai,

verses.original: ἀφόβως ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν ῥυσθέντας λατρεύειν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: aphobōs ek cheiros echthrōn rhysthentas latreuein autō
verses.literal: deliverance from hostile hands that we may serve Him without fear
verses.literalPt: de conceder-nos que, livres da mão dos nossos inimigos, o servíssemos sem temor,

verses.original: ἐν ὁσιότητι καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: en hosiotēti kai dikaiosynē enōpion autou pasais tais hēmerais hēmōn
verses.literal: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives
verses.literalPt: em santidade e justiça diante dele, por todos os nossos dias.

verses.original: Καὶ σὺ δέ παιδίον προφήτης Ὑψίστου κληθήσῃ προπορεύσῃ γὰρ ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ἑτοιμάσαι ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai sy de paidion prophētēs Hypsistou klēthēsē proporeusē gar enōpion Kyriou hetoimasai hodous autou
verses.literal: And . . . you child will be called a prophet of the Most High for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for Him
verses.literalPt: sim, e tu, menino, serás chamado profeta do Altíssimo, porque irás ante a face do Senhor preparar os seus caminhos,

verses.original: τοῦ δοῦναι γνῶσιν σωτηρίας τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀφέσει ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: tou dounai gnōsin sōtērias tō laō autou en aphesei hamartiōn autōn
verses.literal: to give to His people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins
verses.literalPt: para dar ao seu povo conhecimento da salvação, na remissão dos seus pecados,

verses.original: διὰ σπλάγχνα ἐλέους Θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐν οἷς ἐπισκέψεται ἡμᾶς ἀνατολὴ ἐξ ὕψους
verses.transliteration: dia splanchna eleous Theou hēmōn en hois episkepsetai hēmas anatolē ex hypsous
verses.literal: because of the tender mercy of our God by which the Dawn will visit us from on high
verses.literalPt: devido à entranhável misericórdia de nosso Deus, pela qual nos visitará a aurora lá do alto,

verses.original: ἐπιφᾶναι τοῖς ἐν σκότει καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου καθημένοις τοῦ κατευθῦναι τοὺς πόδας ἡμῶν εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης
verses.transliteration: epiphanai tois en skotei kai skia thanatou kathēmenois tou kateuthynai tous podas hēmōn eis hodon eirēnēs
verses.literal: to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death to guide our feet into the path of peace
verses.literalPt: para alumiar os que estão de assento nas trevas e na sombra da morte, para dirigir os nossos pés no caminho da paz.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο πνεύματι καὶ ἦν ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις ἕως ἡμέρας ἀναδείξεως αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: To de paidion ēuxanen kai ekrataiouto pneumati kai ēn en tais erēmois heōs hēmeras anadeixeōs autou pros ton Israēl
verses.literal: And the child grew and became strong in spirit and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to Israel
verses.literalPt: O menino crescia, e se fortalecia em espírito, e habitava nos desertos até o dia da sua manifestação a Israel.
